subject: Tailored walkthrough after your recent activity — 20 min?
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.ai>
To: Ashley Nguyen <ashley@breezyai.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Tailored walkthrough after your recent activity — 20 min?

Hi Ashley,

I noticed your team at BreezyAI has been ramping up usage in the self-serve tier over the past week — congrats on getting things moving. Based on the patterns I’m seeing (higher token counts on embed-heavy workloads), I think a short 20-minute walkthrough focused on: 

- a quick architecture suggestion for lower per-token cost
- batching/caching knobs that map to your usage pattern
- ideal model/quantization options for retrieval-heavy flows

would be helpful. No heavy sales pitch — just practical steps you can take in the next sprint. Marcus (AE) is cc’d and can join for any contract/limits questions.

Are you available for a 20-minute slot Wednesday or Thursday morning PT? If none of these work, drop a couple times that do and I’ll send a calendar invite. I’ve attached a one-pager with the things we usually cover.

Attachment: redwood-one-pager.pdf (PDF, 210KB)

Thanks —
Olga Petrov
SDR | Redwood Inference
olga@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0149

--
Note: I tailored this to the usage spike we saw on 2027-03-19 (embeddings-heavy). If you'd like, I can pull a short token-cost estimate for your last 48 hours before the call.

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Mar 2027 15:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tailored walkthrough after your recent activity — 20 min?

Hi Olga — thanks for the reach out and for flagging the uptick. This is exactly the kind of proactive help we need right now.

I can do Thursday 10:00 AM PT for a quick call. If you can keep it to 20 minutes, that’d be perfect — I have an investor sync at 10:30.

A couple quick asks to make the session useful:
1) a short note on how Redwood handles prefix/KV caching for chat-style sessions
2) any guidance on balancing short-lived vs persistent KV caches for our use case

If you can send an invite and a 1-line agenda, I’ll accept.

Best,
Ashley Nguyen
Head of Integrations | BreezyAI
ashley@breezyai.com | (617) 555-0199

Agenda (20 min):
- 3 min quick intros + use case recap
- 8 min targeted recommendations (caching, batching, model profiles)
- 6 min live Q&A on limits/pricing/fallbacks
- 3 min next steps & optional deeper follow-up (if helpful)

I’ll also pull a 48-hour token-cost snapshot and share it in the invite notes (short table) so we can point to concrete numbers during the call. Marcus — can you join to address contract/throughput questions?
